units.source_text: 所谓封盘，也是名人第一次经历的规则。

en.t: The so-called sealed move was also a rule the Master was experiencing for the first time.

units.source_text: 第二天继续对弈，从红叶馆的保险柜里把信封拿出来，

en.t: When play resumed the next day, the envelope was taken out of the safe at Momijikan,

units.source_text: 在日本棋院的干事也在场的情况下，当着对弈者的面，确认封印；

en.t: and, with an official from the Nihon Ki-in also present, the seal was checked in front of the players;

units.source_text: 昨日在纸上记下封盘最后一手的棋手，先让对手看了棋谱，随后在棋盘上摆放了这一手。

en.t: the player who had written the final sealed move on paper the day before first showed the game record to his opponent, then placed that move on the board.

units.source_text: 在箱根或伊东的旅馆里，反复进行了同样的规定做法。

en.t: At inns in Hakone or Ito, the same prescribed procedure was carried out again and again.

units.source_text: 就是说，不让对手看中途暂停的一应手，就是封盘。

en.t: In other words, a sealed move means not letting the opponent see the one move to be played after the game is paused midway.
